maintenance_led.reason: Site development, grading, utilities and paving for new residential, commercial and municipal projects; mainly new construction, not repair.

publicly_funded.reason: Serves residential, commercial, industrial and municipal projects; mostly private land developers and builders, with municipal only one segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Describes itself as a disciplined acquirer; five operating companies (A.L. Grading, Aviator Paving, Allied Paving) joined into one platform.

mission_critical.reason: Site work contractors are bid competitively per project; customers can switch to another civil contractor easily.

notes: Revenue mix between private and municipal customers is not stated on the website.
